premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/TermAlgebra-evaluation: Interpreted premise: eval(ρ,F,var(x))=ρ(x); eval(ρ,F,app(o,ts))=F(o)(λi.eval(ρ,F,ts(i))). premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/DirectedMultigraph-walk-: Interpreted premise: walk(a,[],b)⇔a=b; walk(a,e::p,b)⇔s(e)=a ∧ walk(t(e),p,b). urn:csabs:concept/PropositionalFormula.mapping: Raw finite syntax over arbitrary AP, primitive atom/bottom/neg/conj. Equality is constructor identity. The catalog macro connectives expand into this basis.
urn:csabs:concept/PropositionalFormula.limitations: Compiled carrier and selected interface only. No new graph law or metatheorem is registered as a proof witness. In particular substitution-support, semantic correspondence, soundness, completeness, compactness and normal-form existence are editorial claims here; grammar/rule declarations do not prove them.

urn:csabs:concept/FirstOrderSignature.mapping: Countable tagged symbol families: functions n and relations n are subsets of Nat, with n the arity. Instantiate Fn n and Pred n as their subtypes. Nullary symbols are allowed; sorts remain distinct.
urn:csabs:concept/FirstOrderSignature.limitations: Compiled carrier and selected interface only. No new graph law or metatheorem is registered as a proof witness. In particular substitution-support, semantic correspondence, soundness, completeness, compactness and normal-form existence are editorial claims here; grammar/rule declarations do not prove them.

urn:csabs:concept/FirstOrderFormula.mapping: Nat names provide the countably infinite variable supply. Arity-indexed Fn/Pred instantiate the signature; terms reuse FirstOrderTerm, a ranked term algebra. Raw named binders preserve syntactic identity. freeVariables and term variables are Set-valued supports (finite by syntax, without a registered finiteness witness). Public substitute requires freeFor; rawSubstitute alone has no capture-free contract.
urn:csabs:concept/FirstOrderFormula.limitations: Compiled carrier and selected interface only. No new graph law or metatheorem is registered as a proof witness. In particular substitution-support, semantic correspondence, soundness, completeness, compactness and normal-form existence are editorial claims here; grammar/rule declarations do not prove them.

urn:csabs:concept/PropositionalNaturalDe.mapping: The inductive Prop-valued relation uses set contexts and finite rule trees: hypothesis, weakening, conjunction introduction/projections, negation introduction/elimination, explosion and classical reductio. AP must be countable when interpreting the catalog completeness/compactness claims.
urn:csabs:concept/PropositionalNaturalDe.limitations: Compiled carrier and selected interface only. No new graph law or metatheorem is registered as a proof witness. In particular substitution-support, semantic correspondence, soundness, completeness, compactness and normal-form existence are editorial claims here; grammar/rule declarations do not prove them.

urn:csabs:concept/FirstOrderNaturalDeduc.mapping: Inductive named-variable derivability on set contexts, with all explicit propositional rules, universal introduction guarded by context freshness, elimination guarded by freeFor, and equality reflexivity/substitution. Existentials and other connectives are macros. Restrict symbol families to the countable signature for the catalog metatheorems.
urn:csabs:concept/FirstOrderNaturalDeduc.limitations: Compiled carrier and selected interface only. No new graph law or metatheorem is registered as a proof witness. In particular substitution-support, semantic correspondence, soundness, completeness, compactness and normal-form existence are editorial claims here; grammar/rule declarations do not prove them.

urn:csabs:concept/FiniteField.mapping: Mathlib Field A with an explicit Finite A witness, equality of elements, and unchanged exact operations. Catalog inverse/division restrict Mathlib total operations to nonzero inputs.
urn:csabs:concept/FiniteField.limitations: No chosen size, polynomial basis or encoding. No proof witnesses for the new finite-field classification or Frobenius results.

urn:csabs:concept/BTree.mapping: Raw RoseTree (List A): each node carries a finite key list and an ordered finite child list. Empty B-tree shape is RoseTree.node [] []. Structural equality preserves keys and child order.
urn:csabs:concept/BTree.limitations: Partial raw-shape interpretation only. Minimum degree, occupancy, arity, key ordering, balance, membership, height and updates are not formalized; no B-tree proof witnesses.

urn:csabs:concept/Lock.mapping: Finite-support P→Option M holder map, symmetric compatibility C and pairwise compatibility proof. Identity equality of holder maps; at most one mode per process. canAcquire and guarded acquires/releases correspond to the recorded atomic state steps.
urn:csabs:concept/Lock.limitations: No waiting queues, scheduling, Boolean decision wrappers, timeouts, memory visibility or implementation refinement. No compiled witnesses for the new graph claims.

urn:csabs:concept/Mutex.mapping: Option P with none unowned and some p owned. acquires/releases are guarded state relations; tryAcquire has exact non-spurious Boolean results. Equality is Option equality and process identity.
urn:csabs:concept/Mutex.limitations: No blocking-call histories, fairness, recursive acquisition, crash recovery or memory fences. No compiled witnesses for the new graph claims.

urn:csabs:concept/LamportBakery.mapping: Raw state for Fin n processes: choosing flags, unbounded Nat tickets, and uninterpreted natural program counters, scan indices and per-process local read data.
urn:csabs:concept/LamportBakery.limitations: No legal control-state invariant, SC transition relation, reachability, protocol refinement, fairness, mutual-exclusion proof or failure/weak-memory model. This binding supplies raw state fields only.

urn:csabs:concept/ObjectHeap.mapping: HeapStore instantiated with class tags and finite qualified-field maps; primitive/reference sum, null Option, partial field access/update, identity and allocated aliasing are explicit.
urn:csabs:concept/ObjectHeap.limitations: Inherited raw heap operations remain available. No typing, encapsulation, lifetime, GC, concurrency or implementation refinement is established.

urn:csabs:concept/ClassTable.mapping: Classes are Fin(n+1); parent/root, finite local declarations and a decreasing auxiliary rank certify the single-inheritance profile. Ancestor/lookup traversal uses n+1 fuel; dispatch reads the heap class tag. Erase rank evidence for extensional table equality.
urn:csabs:concept/ClassTable.limitations: Lookup and ancestors are implemented, but the general proof that n+1 fuel suffices and correspondence with the recursive graph equations is not registered. Bodies are opaque; type safety and behavioral compatibility are absent.

urn:csabs:concept/MethodContract.mapping: Pre/post/writable predicates over fixed-domain total stores; trace after-state, outcome and all writes; allows, satisfies and covered match the selected relational profile. Instantiate Outcome with Sum Result Exception.
urn:csabs:concept/MethodContract.limitations: Allocation, faults outside the outcome carrier, execution instrumentation correctness and termination are not modeled. Preconditions may be empty and coverage is separate.

urn:csabs:concept/ObjectInvariant.mapping: Whole-object-heap predicate, allocated receiver, constructor poststates and receiver-preserving boundary relation. Establishment and preservation are explicit structure hypotheses; reachable uses finite reflexive-transitive closure.
urn:csabs:concept/ObjectInvariant.limitations: Boundary completeness is a client obligation: callbacks and alias interference must be included. No compiled reachable-valid witness or hidden-instruction, liveness or concurrency claim is registered.

urn:csabs:concept/BehavioralSubtyping.mapping: Explicit legal-state, method-coverage, pre/post and history-constraint implications under an abstraction function and method map. Fixed input/outcome carriers encode already-compatible signatures; historyPair records all admissible ordered history pairs.
urn:csabs:concept/BehavioralSubtyping.limitations: The semantic implications are modeled, but connection of historyPair to actual executions, general signature adapters, full trace/contextual substitutability and total correctness remain obligations. No nominal inheritance implication or subtype theorem is asserted.

urn:csabs:concept/HeapSeparation.mapping: Extensional HeapStore(V) predicates; disjoint domains, relational graph of partial merge, exact emp/singleton and existential star splitting. Model equality of predicates by pointwise logical equivalence.
urn:csabs:concept/HeapSeparation.limitations: Selected mathematical interface, with merge given relationally. No general frame rule, local operational semantics, fractional permissions, concurrent rule or automatically proved separation laws is registered.

urn:csabs:concept/TemplateMetafunction.mapping: Kind-correct List Arg to Option Result in a fixed environment; TemplateArgument supplies disjoint type/value/template tags; partial composition is explicit. Instantiate carriers with canonical argument identities and result observations.
urn:csabs:concept/TemplateMetafunction.limitations: The function is a mathematical interpretation, not a decision procedure for compilation, equivalence, instantiation termination or compiler limits. Apply only after target-environment and canonical-argument mapping.

urn:csabs:concept/TemplateSpecialization.mapping: Finite matching set, explicit irreflexive/transitive more-specialized relation, winner predicate and Primary/Chosen/Ambiguous selection.
urn:csabs:concept/TemplateSpecialization.limitations: Deduction, associated constraints, standard C++ partial ordering and visibility are supplied adapters, not inferred from match-set inclusion. No general compiler or chosen-body correctness theorem is registered.

urn:csabs:concept/TemplateSubstitution.mapping: Ordered Continue/ImmediateInvalid/RequiredHardError events with a stopping scan; a supplied frontend connects environment, substitution and syntax to events and a successful artifact.
urn:csabs:concept/TemplateSubstitution.limitations: Actual syntactic substitution, lexical event generation, access checking and immediate-context/side-effect classification remain frontend obligations. IFNDR cases are excluded. No complete C++ deduction algorithm or SFINAE theorem is registered.

urn:csabs:concept/TemplateConstraint.mapping: Atom/conjunction/disjunction trees, three-way short-circuit satisfaction, DNF/CNF clauses and identity-based subsumption. Atom equality must encode resolved source-expression origin and parameter mappings.
urn:csabs:concept/TemplateConstraint.limitations: Actual C++ normalization, argument substitution, atomic equivalence and constant-expression checking remain adapters. Invalid normalization/IFNDR and later-standard fold-expanded subsumption are outside the profile.

urn:csabs:concept/TemplateParameterPack.mapping: List of canonical same-kind arguments; map expansion, length-checked zip expansion and explicit left/right binary fold trees.
urn:csabs:concept/TemplateParameterPack.limitations: Kind compatibility and actual pattern validity must be established before using the pure pattern functions. Unary empty-fold typing and language grammar are stated in the catalog but not separate Lean wrappers; no evaluation-order or universal compiler equivalence claim.

urn:csabs:concept/DependentNameLookup.mapping: Finite ordinary-definition, ADL-definition and ADL-instantiation candidate sets with an explicit ADL-enable guard; candidates uses the guarded union.
urn:csabs:concept/DependentNameLookup.limitations: Classification of dependent names, admissible ADL sets/guard and visibility are supplied frontend facts. Qualified/member lookup, modules, cross-TU consistency and overload ranking are excluded; no complete name resolver is claimed.

urn:csabs:concept/CompileTimeEvaluation.mapping: Closed Lit/Add/Mul/Boolean-branch syntax and an Option Int evaluator with per-step signed range checks. Instantiate width at least 16 and a signed type of rank at least int; literal leaves are in range.
urn:csabs:concept/CompileTimeEvaluation.limitations: Not a complete constexpr machine: no calls, recursion, pointers, state, promotions or required-context classification. Exclude malformed literals and record target integer width and compiler resource limits. No new law/theorem witness is registered.

urn:csabs:concept/GenericSignature.mapping: Finite ordered name/kind pairs with distinct names; kindOf supplies canonical argument tags. kindCorrect uses pointwise Forall₂, including exact length.
urn:csabs:concept/GenericSignature.limitations: Language-specific kind compatibility, bounds, defaults and pack flattening are separate; no universal generic type system or theorem witness.

urn:csabs:concept/GenericArgumentBinding.mapping: Resolved actual slots and prefix-dependent defaults; bind traverses declaration slots, gives explicit actuals precedence, checks kinds and appends one result per slot. Decidable kind equality is an implementation convention.
urn:csabs:concept/GenericArgumentBinding.limitations: Association syntax, duplicate/unknown-name rejection, inference and full simultaneous bounds are preceding/following language adapters. Selected ordered-default profile only.

urn:csabs:concept/ParametricInstantiatio.mapping: Explicit signature, admissibility and realization relation with simultaneous name/argument zip. Instantiation remains a relation, allowing fresh/generative instance identities.
urn:csabs:concept/ParametricInstantiatio.limitations: Actual syntax substitution, binder hygiene, language body semantics and realization/instance identity are supplied. A complete shared substitution calculus is not implemented.

urn:csabs:concept/JavaParameterizedType.mapping: Well-formed declaration, arity, reference/wildcard forms, capture-adjusted bounds, member substitution and reflexive-transitive closure of a supplied nominal direct-supertype relation.
urn:csabs:concept/JavaParameterizedType.limitations: Faithful Java declaration checks, capture, full member accessibility and JLS direct-supertype/containment rules remain adapters; this is not a subtype checker or universal behavioral guarantee.

urn:csabs:concept/JavaWildcardCapture.mapping: Exact/unbounded/upper/lower argument constructors; per-slot capture bounds, simultaneous declared-bound adapter, fresh distinct variables and nonrecursive outer-argument processing.
urn:csabs:concept/JavaWildcardCapture.limitations: Resolved nominal identities, intersection validity, well-formed input bounds and Java scoping remain frontend obligations. Capture is relational, not a unique runtime conversion.

urn:csabs:concept/JavaTypeErasure.mapping: Named/parameterized/array/variable type core, plus an unbounded wildcard marker used only inside arguments; fuel-bounded erasure discards argument lists and follows the supplied leftmost variable bound.
urn:csabs:concept/JavaTypeErasure.limitations: Nested-owner typing, reifiability and signature translation are not encoded; adequate fuel and terminating well-formed bound chains require justification. Fuel exhaustion does not establish invalidity. No JVM translation or erasure theorem witness.

urn:csabs:concept/JavaTypeInference.mapping: Assignments to proper in-scope types, supplied interpreted constraints and an explicitly sound partial resolver; solutions is the all-obligations predicate.
urn:csabs:concept/JavaTypeInference.limitations: Actual JLS reduction, incorporation, applicability/target stages, capture/boxing/lambda rules and resolution algorithms are not implemented. Soundness is an explicit structure hypothesis, not proof about javac or arbitrary resolver code.

urn:csabs:concept/VHDLGenericInterface.mapping: Constant/type/subprogram/package kinds; finite distinct signature, compatibility/default obligations and whole-formal positional-prefix/named association normalizer. Unknown/repeated targets and late positional associations are rejected.
urn:csabs:concept/VHDLGenericInterface.limitations: Selected whole-formal interface only. Subtype/type-category/profile/package matching, default expressions and anonymous generic type associations require language adapters; syntax normalization does not execute elaboration.

urn:csabs:concept/VHDLGenericElaboration.mapping: Ordered event execution with partial environment steps and final instance construction; separate staticness predicates and finite list-valued for/if generation.
urn:csabs:concept/VHDLGenericElaboration.limitations: Events must encode declaration order and applicable header phases; concrete VHDL evaluation, conformance, staticness, configurations, package identity and simulation are not implemented. GHDL examples require separate tool evidence.

urn:csabs:concept/AEAD.mapping: Abstract deterministic seal/open and functional correctness as a structure hypothesis. Option.none denotes FAIL; some empty plaintext remains distinct.
urn:csabs:concept/AEAD.limitations: Length domains, byte encoding, nonce histories, failure-release behavior and computational security are not encoded. No registered claim witness.

urn:csabs:concept/AES.mapping: Supported key width 128/192/256 and a parameterized permutation on 128-bit blocks.
urn:csabs:concept/AES.limitations: No FIPS round computation, key expansion, field representation or correspondence proof; the supplied permutation is not asserted to be AES.

urn:csabs:concept/AESGCM.mapping: Carrier containing the partial AES component interface.
urn:csabs:concept/AESGCM.limitations: No FIPS algorithm implementation, AES/GCM composition equations, byte wire encoding, authenticated decryption or security proof.

urn:csabs:concept/BlockCipher.mapping: Key-indexed Equiv on Fin n → Bool, with exact function equality. Require n≥1 and nonempty K at instantiation.
urn:csabs:concept/BlockCipher.limitations: Permutation model only; no key-generation distribution, pseudorandomness, mode or side-channel properties.

urn:csabs:concept/GCM.mapping: Carrier for a parameterized 128-bit keyed block permutation.
urn:csabs:concept/GCM.limitations: Counter transform, GHASH composition, nonce/tag lengths, length blocks, tag verification, uniqueness discipline and GCM claims remain unformalized.

urn:csabs:concept/GHASH.mapping: 128-bit subkey, parameterized multiplication, and XOR Horner fold over an explicit head plus tail (nonempty sequence).
urn:csabs:concept/GHASH.limitations: Multiplication has no field-law or polynomial-encoding constraint. No verified NIST multiplication, polynomial theorem or security bound.

urn:csabs:concept/IdempotentSemiring.mapping: Catalog.IdempotentSemiring A extends Mathlib Semiring A with the structural law ∀ a, a+a=a. Same carrier equality and total operations; zero=one allowed. canonicalSemiringOrder a b is a+b=b.
urn:csabs:concept/IdempotentSemiring.limitations: Carrier and interface binding only. No registered witness for the new canonical-order theorems; the graph statements and source correspondence remain editorial.

urn:csabs:concept/MinPlusSemiring.mapping: MinTropical (WithTop ℝ), exact extended real equality; tropical addition=min, multiplication=extended ordinary addition, zero=+∞, one=real 0. The IdempotentSemiring instance uses Mathlib add_self. canonicalSemiringOrder is reverse numerical order; do not use the transported library ≤ as the canonical order.
urn:csabs:concept/MinPlusSemiring.limitations: Carrier and interface binding only. No registered witness for the new canonical-order theorems; the graph statements and source correspondence remain editorial.

urn:csabs:concept/BlockCode.mapping: Nonempty Finset of Fin n→A with positive n. Instantiate a finite alphabet with at least two symbols.
urn:csabs:concept/BlockCode.limitations: Encoder bijection, nearest-set decoder, failure, distance distribution and partial dmin operations omitted. These are model bindings, not proofs of the catalog theorems.

urn:csabs:concept/CVP.mapping: EuclideanLattice, target and gamma>=1; admissible uses squared Euclidean residuals against every lattice competitor; permits ties and rank zero.
urn:csabs:concept/CVP.limitations: No distance/minimizer construction, relation-equivalence or attainment witness, solver or finite bit encoding. Correspondence of the all-competitor relation to the minimum-distance formulation remains unproved.

urn:csabs:concept/ChannelCapacity.mapping: Supremum of nonnegative achievable rates, with explicit ChannelCode sequences, positive message counts, uniform-message average block error, positive block lengths and eventual lower-rate/vanishing-error criteria.
urn:csabs:concept/ChannelCapacity.limitations: Shannon equality with the information expression and coding theorems are formulated but unproved.

urn:csabs:concept/ConditionalEntropy.mapping: Finite normalized joint Law; conditional entropy is a joint-mass weighted log ratio using the Y marginal. Null joint masses vanish.
urn:csabs:concept/ConditionalEntropy.limitations: Conditional laws and chain-rule correspondence unproved. These are model bindings, not proofs of the catalog theorems.

urn:csabs:concept/DiffieHellman.mapping: Group H with an explicit generator and subgroupOrder; publicValue uses natural group power and Lean equality.
urn:csabs:concept/DiffieHellman.limitations: Does not enforce finite prime order, generator order, secret range, subgroup membership, sampling, shared-secret agreement, encodings, KDF or authentication.

urn:csabs:concept/DiscreteMemorylessChan.mapping: Stationary n-fold product of a normalized finite kernel; blockLaw constructs the resulting law with proved normalization. n=0 uses the empty product; operational codes use n+1.
urn:csabs:concept/DiscreteMemorylessChan.limitations: No feedback or input-cost constraints. Shannon coding targets remain unproved.

urn:csabs:concept/DistortionMeasure.mapping: Exact real cost A→B→Real with nonnegativity, instantiated on finite nonempty alphabets.
urn:csabs:concept/DistortionMeasure.limitations: Normalized block averaging and expectation operation omitted. These are model bindings, not proofs of the catalog theorems.

urn:csabs:concept/DualCode.mapping: Submodule constructed by the ordinary bilinear dot-product orthogonality predicate. The compiled bridge to Mathlib orthogonal complements proves dimension and double-dual claims over any finite field, including characteristic two.
urn:csabs:concept/DualCode.limitations: No Hermitian dual or decoding algorithm. Apply to the submodule of a positive-length LinearCode.

urn:csabs:concept/ECC.mapping: Abstract AddCommGroup Point with a basePoint and subgroupOrder; publicPoint uses natural scalar multiplication. Equality is Lean point equality; zero interprets O.
urn:csabs:concept/ECC.limitations: No field/affine representation, nonsingularity, selected subgroup, base-point order, coordinate equivalence or correspondence to the slope formulas is established.

urn:csabs:concept/ECDH.mapping: ECCInterface Point under AddCommGroup; sharedPoint uses natural scalar multiplication of a supplied peer point.
urn:csabs:concept/ECDH.limitations: No validation, prime-order or nonzero-scalar restrictions, full-point encoding, agreement witness, KDF or authentication. A supplied abstract group is not a verified curve implementation.

urn:csabs:concept/EuclideanLattice.mapping: Independent finite real columns and an existential integer-combination membership predicate; vector equality is pointwise. Rank zero is allowed.
urn:csabs:concept/EuclideanLattice.limitations: No covolume or dual operation, generated Group instance, discreteness proof, basis-change proof or catalog claim witness. A real coordinate function space is used with an explicit squared Euclidean norm, not its default Pi norm.

urn:csabs:concept/GeneratorMatrix.mapping: A finite row basis of the exact code subspace, its inverse coordinate linear equivalence, and an explicit generatorMatrix with a compiled coordinate equation identifying encoding with mG.
urn:csabs:concept/GeneratorMatrix.limitations: No efficient basis-finding algorithm or runtime representation refinement.

urn:csabs:concept/HammingSpace.mapping: Fin n→A words and Nat count of unequal coordinates, with decidable symbol equality. Instantiate n≥1 and finite alphabet of size at least two.
urn:csabs:concept/HammingSpace.limitations: Hamming balls and metric-law witnesses omitted. These are model bindings, not proofs of the catalog theorems.

urn:csabs:concept/LWE.mapping: Positive dimension, modulus q>=2, normalized FiniteDistribution on ZMod q; encode computes the exact modular dot product plus supplied error.
urn:csabs:concept/LWE.limitations: Uniform input sampling, independent errors, one reused secret, joint sample distributions, search/decision experiments and probability/security witnesses are not constructed.

urn:csabs:concept/LinearBlockCode.mapping: Submodule F (Fin n→F) for a finite field F, with positive n. Equality is submodule extensional equality.
urn:csabs:concept/LinearBlockCode.limitations: No weight, dimension, size or minimum-distance witnesses. These are model bindings, not proofs of the catalog theorems.

urn:csabs:concept/MutualInformation.mapping: Finite joint law and marginal-product log ratio in bits.
urn:csabs:concept/MutualInformation.limitations: Conditional mutual information operation and data processing theorem are not formalized. These are model bindings, not proofs of the catalog theorems.

urn:csabs:concept/NonlinearBlockCode.mapping: Nonempty finite field codebook together with failure to coincide with any submodule, with pointwise word equality.
urn:csabs:concept/NonlinearBlockCode.limitations: No chosen nonlinearity witness or decoding operations; finite-field alphabet identification must be supplied. These are model bindings, not proofs of the catalog theorems.

urn:csabs:concept/ParityCheckMatrix.mapping: Surjective linear check map with code kernel; parityMatrix materializes the concrete matrix and parity_coordinates proves equality with matrix-vector multiplication. Both directions of full-rank generator/check orthogonality are proved.
urn:csabs:concept/ParityCheckMatrix.limitations: Boolean checker operation is still represented through the zero comparison rather than a separate named Boolean API; no check-matrix construction algorithm.

urn:csabs:concept/PrefixFreeCode.mapping: M→List Bool with positive lengths and prefix implication forcing equal source symbols.
urn:csabs:concept/PrefixFreeCode.limitations: Parsing and correspondence to UniqueCode omitted; no unique-decoding theorem witness. These are model bindings, not proofs of the catalog theorems.

urn:csabs:concept/QaryLattice.mapping: Modular matrix with positive n,m, q>=2 and kernel membership for integer column vectors through ZMod q arithmetic; composite moduli allowed.
urn:csabs:concept/QaryLattice.limitations: No extracted integer/real lattice basis, index theorem, distribution of matrices or registered full-rank witness.

urn:csabs:concept/RSA.mapping: Nat modulus and public/private exponents; publicMap/privateMap compute exact natural powers modulo modulus. On valid catalog keys and representatives these are the selected exponent maps.
urn:csabs:concept/RSA.limitations: The interface is broader than the catalog: zero modulus, invalid exponents and out-of-range representatives are not rejected. Prime factors, lambda congruence, errors, inverse equations, byte encoding, OAEP and PSS are not modeled.

urn:csabs:concept/RateDistortion.mapping: Extended-nonnegative-real infimum of mutual information over actual normalized reconstruction kernels meeting kernelCost≤D; inf ∅=∞. Separate operationalRD uses iid source blocks, deterministic lossy codes and eventual upper bounds on rate and expected average distortion. Instantiate D≥0 and finite nonempty alphabets.
urn:csabs:concept/RateDistortion.limitations: Monotonicity/convexity and Shannon rate-distortion equality are formulated but unproved. ENNReal.ofReal encodes nonnegative information values; general MI nonnegativity remains an explicit unproved target.

urn:csabs:concept/RelativeEntropy.mapping: Two exact normalized finite laws; None denotes positive infinity on support mismatch; Some value is the finite KL sum in bits.
urn:csabs:concept/RelativeEntropy.limitations: No Gibbs inequality witness; Option encoding of extended values needs API mapping. These are model bindings, not proofs of the catalog theorems.

urn:csabs:concept/SIS.mapping: QaryLattice and real bound 0<beta<q; admissible uses a nonzero integer vector, zero syndrome and squared Euclidean bound.
urn:csabs:concept/SIS.limitations: Uniform average-case matrix sampling, collision/pigeonhole witnesses, solvers, success probabilities and hardness assumptions are not formalized.

urn:csabs:concept/SVP.mapping: Positive-rank EuclideanLattice and gamma>=1; admissible is membership, nonzeroness and the squared Euclidean bound against every nonzero competitor.
urn:csabs:concept/SVP.limitations: No lambda_1 construction, minimizer existence or relation-equivalence witness, solver, finite bit encoding or complexity bound. The all-competitor relation corresponds to the catalog minimum relation using its editorial attainment result, which is not compiled here.

urn:csabs:concept/ShannonEntropy.mapping: Exact normalized real Law on a finite alphabet; entropy is the negative sum of mass times log base 2.
urn:csabs:concept/ShannonEntropy.limitations: No entropy inequalities or source coding theorem witness. These are model bindings, not proofs of the catalog theorems.

urn:csabs:concept/StochasticChannel.mapping: A→Law B with exact nonnegative normalized rows; outputMass/output compute the finite output distribution, whose nonnegativity and normalization are proved.
urn:csabs:concept/StochasticChannel.limitations: No random sampler, floating-point implementation or channel-memory model.

urn:csabs:concept/Syndrome.mapping: Actual check linear map applied to finite-field received vectors; parity_coordinates identifies it with a concrete check-matrix product. The full zero/coset/error-invariance theorem is proved.
urn:csabs:concept/Syndrome.limitations: No error-leader selection or efficient error reconstruction.

urn:csabs:concept/UniquelyDecodableCode.mapping: M→List Bool with nonempty words and injective flatMap concatenation on List M; word equality.
urn:csabs:concept/UniquelyDecodableCode.limitations: Decoding inverse and expected-length operation omitted; no Kraft witness. These are model bindings, not proofs of the catalog theorems.

urn:csabs:concept/AsymmetricCoroutine.mapping: K,I,O,R,E are Lean types; CoroutineState is the tagged lifecycle carrier. entry selects the created state, accept injects resume input, and internal/yields/returns/raises are body relations. coroutineStep gives exactly the six lifecycle rules; coroutineLTS exposes the singleton initial state; coroutineOutcomes observes a resume, finite internal closure and one boundary event. Equality is Lean structural equality.
urn:csabs:concept/AsymmetricCoroutine.limitations: Body semantics and retained heap/stack contents must be supplied by the instantiation. No language frontend, nested caller stack, shared-memory interference, cancellation, throw/close, fairness, divergence classification or complete runtime conformance is encoded. Only the separately registered successive-resumes-require-yield theorem has a compiled claim witness when verification evidence is fresh. Other graph claims and runtime correspondence remain separate obligations.

urn:csabs:concept/CooperativeScheduler.mapping: Finite Lean task type T indexes a fixed family of coroutine models. CooperativeState stores a total task-state map, optional active owner and waiting Set. cooperativeInitial, cooperativeRunnable and cooperativeStep implement initialization, eligibility and all seven action rules; cooperativeLTS exposes the labelled system. Function.update changes only the selected task; cooperativeValid states the owner and waiting invariant. Structural equality is used throughout.
urn:csabs:concept/CooperativeScheduler.limitations: Typed fixed-pool operational model only; event identities, event readiness, real IO, fairness, wake delivery, cancellation, dynamic tasks and shared-memory interference require explicit extensions. Waiting is an explicit scheduler request, not every coroutine yield or syntactic await. Only the separately registered reachable-owner-invariant and cooperation-does-not-imply-progress theorems have compiled claim witnesses when verification evidence is fresh. Other claims and runtime correspondence remain separate obligations.

urn:csabs:theorem/AsymmetricCoroutine-su.expectedType: ∀ {K I O R E : Type u} (m : Catalog.AsymmetricCoroutine K I O R E) (leading middle trailing : List (Catalog.CoroutineAction I O R E)) (i j : I) (last : Catalog.CoroutineState K R E), Catalog.LabelledPath (Catalog.coroutineLTS m) (.created m.entry) (leading ++ (.resume i :: (middle ++ (.resume j :: trailing)))) last → ∃ o, Catalog.CoroutineAction.yieldValue o ∈ middle
urn:csabs:theorem/AsymmetricCoroutine-su.mapping: Lean tagged states/actions preserve continuation and input/output carriers. The independently reviewed expected type quantifies over a complete finite path and two Resume positions. It proves a yield exists in the intervening word, even without requiring these positions to be consecutive resumes. Equality and list membership are structural.

premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/AsymmetricCoroutine-resu: coroutineStep permits Resume only from Created or Suspended and targets Running(accept k i); coroutineLTS starts in Created(entry).
premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/AsymmetricCoroutine-body: coroutineStep enumerates all internal and boundary transitions. Unresumable and step_without_yield show that a no-yield segment cannot enable another Resume.
premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/LabelledTransitionSystem: LabelledPath represents every finite labelled path including nil. path_split separates leading, middle and trailing subpaths without an extra trace axiom.

urn:csabs:theorem/AsymmetricCoroutine-su.limitations: Proves the stated finite-trace property of coroutineStep, not language-runtime correspondence, infinite progress, cancellation, nested transfer or hidden-action equivalence.

urn:csabs:theorem/CooperativeScheduler-r.expectedType: ∀ {T K I O R E : Type u} [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T] (m : Catalog.CooperativeScheduler T K I O R E) (s : Catalog.CooperativeState T K R E), Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => ∃ label, Catalog.cooperativeStep m a label b) (Catalog.cooperativeInitial m) s → Catalog.cooperativeValid s
urn:csabs:theorem/CooperativeScheduler-r.mapping: Finite T indexes the fixed pool. cooperativeValid expands to: a task has Running state iff active=some task, and every waiting task is Suspended. ReflTransGen of existentially labelled cooperativeStep is exactly finite scheduler reachability from cooperativeInitial; every transition case is proved, not assumed.

premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/CooperativeScheduler-ini: cooperativeInitial constructs the singleton starting configuration; initial_valid proves the owner/waiting invariant directly.
premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/CooperativeScheduler-dis: The dispatch branch of cooperativeStep requires no owner and a nonwaiting local Resume step; replace_valid proves its task-map update preserves validity.
premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/CooperativeScheduler-own: step_preserves_valid covers Internal, Yield, Wait, Return and Raise separately. Only the owner changes; Wait inserts its now-suspended task in waiting.
premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/CooperativeScheduler-ext: The Wake branch only removes waiting membership and preserves the task map and active owner.
premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/AsymmetricCoroutine-resu: resume_target derives the Running target from coroutineStep; no global axiom assumes it.
premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/AsymmetricCoroutine-body: running_step_target derives each target phase from the local operational rules. Induction over ReflTransGen lifts preservation to all finitely reachable states.

urn:csabs:theorem/CooperativeScheduler-r.limitations: Proves a safety invariant of the supplied abstract rules. No scheduler implementation refinement, fairness, termination, real IO, shared-memory or dynamic-task claim follows.

urn:csabs:theorem/CooperativeScheduler-c.expectedType: ∀ {T K I O R E : Type u} [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T] (m : Catalog.CooperativeScheduler T K I O R E) (s : Catalog.CooperativeState T K R E) (j h : T) (k : K), Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => ∃ label, Catalog.cooperativeStep m a label b) (Catalog.cooperativeInitial m) s → Catalog.cooperativeValid s → j ≠ h → s.active = some j → h ∈ Catalog.cooperativeRunnable s → s.tasks j = .running k → (m.machine j).internal k k → ∃ run : Nat → Catalog.CooperativeState T K R E, run 0 = s ∧ ∀ n, run n = s ∧ Catalog.cooperativeStep m (run n) .internal (run (n + 1)) ∧ (run n).active = some j ∧ h ∈ Catalog.cooperativeRunnable (run n) ∧ ¬ (∃ k', (run n).tasks h = .running k')
urn:csabs:theorem/CooperativeScheduler-c.mapping: The expected type explicitly assumes a reachable valid state, distinct active/ready tasks and an internal self-loop. It constructs a constant Nat-indexed path with a valid Internal transition at every index; the other task stays runnable and never Running. No fairness restriction is added. A concrete Bool-task example separately demonstrates the hypotheses are realizable.

premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/CooperativeScheduler-own: The Internal branch lifts the supplied local self-loop to a global self-loop; cooperativeUpdate is proved equal to the original state. A Nat-indexed constant run witnesses the infinite execution.
premiseMapping.urn:csabs:axiom/AsymmetricCoroutine-body: coroutineStep on Running k with Internal reduces exactly to the hypothesized body relation internal k k. Reachability, validity, distinct tasks, ownership, readiness and the self-loop are explicit theorem hypotheses, as in the graph claim.

urn:csabs:theorem/CooperativeScheduler-c.limitations: Conditional existence of one starving execution; it does not assert that every scheduler or coroutine starves, or that the model satisfies any fairness policy. The assumptions are not global axioms.

urn:csabs:concept/LLVMFloatingPointSeman.mapping: Abstract value/environment carriers, NaN/infinity predicates, outcome relation and a permittedRewrite relation.
urn:csabs:concept/LLVMFloatingPointSeman.limitations: No implemented IEEE arithmetic, bit encodings, NaN payload propagation, constrained-FP engine or complete fast-math semantics; value/exception/permission predicates are client supplied.

urn:csabs:concept/PredicatedVectorSemant.mapping: Runtime width parameter, bounded EVL, Boolean mask and explicit inactive-result sets; activeLane gives the bounded mask condition.
urn:csabs:concept/PredicatedVectorSemant.limitations: No scalable vector runtime, poison-mask semantics, lane evaluator, shuffle/reduction implementation or memory-access proof. Boolean masks represent only the well-defined-mask subprofile.

urn:csabs:concept/AtomicMemoryModel.mapping: Raw execution-edge relations and allowed proposition; atomicHappensBefore computes the stated transitive closure.
urn:csabs:concept/AtomicMemoryModel.limitations: No complete LLVM/C++ weak-memory axiomatization, read-value constraints, release sequences, scopes, fences, cmpxchg or race/UB model. Raw edges alone do not certify atomic transformations.

urn:csabs:concept/CallEffectContract.mapping: Precondition, full outcome relation and allowed-effect relation with effectSound.
urn:csabs:concept/CallEffectContract.limitations: No evaluator, ABI, stack, determinism, termination, exception, bundle or external-library model. Outcome types must explicitly include all relevant behaviors.

urn:csabs:concept/ExceptionalControlFlow.limitations: No personality evaluator, landingpad/funclet machine, cleanup stack, setjmp/longjmp or deoptimization implementation; only the outcome distinction is encoded.

urn:csabs:concept/ConvergentExecution.mapping: Instance-indexed participant sets and allowedResult/sameCommunication predicates.
urn:csabs:concept/ConvergentExecution.limitations: No dynamic instance/token semantics, thread-group construction, uniformity analysis or proof of LLVM convergence restrictions; raw client predicates are partial interfaces.

urn:csabs:concept/StateRepresentation.mapping: Cross-carrier relation and source/target observation functions with observationAgreement.
urn:csabs:concept/StateRepresentation.limitations: No representation invariant implementation, memory promotion/SROA algorithm, operation simulation, GC relocation or coroutine frame proof. Observation agreement alone supplies no full refinement theorem.

urn:csabs:concept/SymbolLinkage.mapping: Environment-admissibility predicate, set-valued resolution and exposed-symbol relation.
urn:csabs:concept/SymbolLinkage.limitations: No linker, COMDAT/ODR/interposition algorithm, root closure or whole-program callgraph proof. The environment must model platform ABI and runtime uses explicitly.

urn:csabs:concept/LLVMAttributeContract.mapping: Admitted-input and guarantee predicates with a justified entailment field.
urn:csabs:concept/LLVMAttributeContract.limitations: No parser/classification of actual LLVM attributes, flags or metadata, no inference engine, and no ABI/bundle implementation. Client entailment is a hypothesis, not an Attributor proof.

urn:csabs:concept/RuntimeInstrumentation.mapping: Per-event finite-list erasure and accepted-execution predicate; eraseInstrumentation is list flatMap.
urn:csabs:concept/RuntimeInstrumentation.limitations: No sanitizer/profiler/GC implementation, invalid-input detection proof, helper-runtime safety proof or infinite-trace projection. Semantic transparency requires extra runtime assumptions.

urn:csabs:concept/ControlFlowGraph.mapping: Finite vertex carrier; directed relation, distinct entry/exit and explicit unique-source/sink conditions.
urn:csabs:concept/ControlFlowGraph.limitations: No normalization algorithm, path enumeration, or proof of the recorded maximal-path law; boundary structure does not imply termination.

urn:csabs:concept/MonotoneDataflow.mapping: Finite graph, complete lattice, boundary facts and edge-qualified monotone transfers. The step declaration uses suprema for the forward join equations.
urn:csabs:concept/MonotoneDataflow.limitations: No concretization soundness proof, solver, convergence proof or registered least-solution witness.

urn:csabs:concept/IntervalDomain.mapping: Subtype of Set Int satisfying integer order-convexity; equality is extensional set equality. Empty, singleton and unbounded sets are representable.
urn:csabs:concept/IntervalDomain.limitations: No Lean lattice instance, hull, abstract arithmetic or widening implementation; carrier model only. No proof witnesses registered.

urn:csabs:concept/RewriteSystem.mapping: Arbitrary step relation on A; reduces is Relation.ReflTransGen and normalForm excludes step successors.
urn:csabs:concept/RewriteSystem.limitations: No matching engine, term substitution/context closure, strategy, termination, confluence or refinement proof.

urn:csabs:concept/EffectAlgebra.mapping: Total join and sequence on E, sequential identity and explicit semilattice/monoid/distributivity fields; subeffect is join-induced ordering.
urn:csabs:concept/EffectAlgebra.limitations: No interpretation of concrete program executions, effect-inference soundness, atomic effects, iteration, concurrency, or quantum-logical effects. No registered theorem witnesses.

urn:csabs:concept/SingleParentForest.mapping: Finite V, Option-valued parent and explicit absence of positive child-to-parent cycles. Equality is vertex equality.
urn:csabs:concept/SingleParentForest.limitations: No root-following implementation, unique-root proof or update algorithm; no dangling references by typing. No witnesses registered.

urn:csabs:concept/SKOS.mapping: D is a nonempty domain of interpreted resources with identity equality. concept and the five binary relations interpret the corresponding SKOS extensions. The fields encode selected typing, inverse, inclusion, symmetry, transitivity and disjointness conditions from S19–S27 and S44–S45.
urn:csabs:concept/SKOS.limitations: Partial semantic-relation interface only. No labels, schemes, collections, full mapping hierarchy, RDF parser/interpretation, OWL Full metamodel, or general entailment solver. Structure law fields constrain inputs; no model-satisfaction theorem or catalog claim proof witness is registered.

urn:csabs:concept/StochasticProcess.mapping: T is an arbitrary index type, Ω carries P, E is measurable; value is the total family and measurable proves every coordinate is measurable. Equality is pointwise via structure equality.
urn:csabs:concept/StochasticProcess.limitations: No joint measurability, path regularity, almost-sure quotient, independence or Markov law. Law operations are specified mathematically and not wrapped in this module.
